# MemoryHooker

Local-first memory reminders and retrieval for coding-agent lifecycle hooks.

Last-checked: 2026-08-03
Ecosystem: ellmos-ai
Umbrella: open-bricks

## Important files

- README.md: public usage, configuration, providers, backends, and boundaries.
- SECURITY.md: private vulnerability-reporting requirements.
- PROVENANCE.md: clean-history and BACH lineage statement.
- memoryhooker/config.py: configuration schema and safe defaults.
- memoryhooker/backends/: local read-only retrieval adapters.
- memoryhooker/providers/: host-specific snippet generators.
- tests/: automated behavior and provider-contract tests.

## Safety properties

- The package performs no network requests.
- Host configuration is never edited automatically.
- The Gardener backend opens configured databases read-only.
- Unavailable backends fail open and produce no hits.
